latest_cos_commentary.headline: Tattle is a venture-funded AI guest-feedback and reputation-management platform for restaurants, positioned as an add-on to POS/ordering systems rather than a POS replacement.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: Adjacent to Genius's loyalty_engagement line via guest satisfaction data, but does not compete on core pos, payments, or back_office functionality.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: Aggregator data points to a Series A round in August 2025; no primary-source confirmation of this or more recent 2026 activity was found.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: Position Genius's loyalty_engagement capabilities as native to the POS stack versus a bolt-on feedback layer when this vendor appears in a deal.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: No specific named restaurant customers were verified (only an unverified "250+ brands" claim); funding figures are from a secondary aggregator, not confirmed primary sourcing.

verification_needed: Named restaurant customers (site claims "250+ leading brands" but names none)
